edits.name: native-pregame-era-type-slot
edits.reason: Aspyr's ICvPreGame1 has a by-value era Type string getter immediately after era(). Restore its slot so every subsequent engine call reaches the correct CP method. The native name is stripped; the explicit Mac name describes its verified behavior.

edits.name: native-pregame-era-type-implementation-declaration
edits.reason: Declare the thin Mac-only implementation of Aspyr's additional pregame slot; the method body lives in host_bridge.cpp.

edits.name: native-critical-section-storage
edits.reason: Aspyr's exported constructor/destructor and Enter/Leave operate on a 40-byte, 8-aligned native critical section, including a mutex pointer at offset 24. The upstream non-Windows declaration is empty and corrupts adjacent FObjectPool state. Preserve the native implementation; only supply its reviewed storage.

edits.name: lua-noreturn-attribute-position
edits.reason: Apple Clang rejects extern [[noreturn]] in this declaration position; the GNU attribute preserves the annotation.

edits.name: native-guid-fallback-suppression
edits.reason: The SDK non-Windows fallback makes GUID.Data1 an LP64 unsigned long. Native builds supply the verified fixed-width GUID without enabling Windows-only code globally.

edits.name: dependent-vector-base-member-lookup
edits.reason: Standard C++ dependent-base lookup requires member qualification; using declarations preserve vector behavior and object layout.

edits.name: dependent-container-iterator-typename
edits.reason: Standard C++ requires typename for this dependent iterator type.

edits.name: container-stream-read-access
edits.reason: Use the public stream operator to reach the same protected native integer reader.

edits.name: container-stream-write-access
edits.reason: Use the public stream operator to reach the same protected native integer writer.

edits.name: lp64-lua-integer-specialization
edits.pattern: template<> inline long Get\(lua_State \*L, int idx\) \{ return \(long\)lua_tointeger\(L, idx\); \}
edits.replacement: // lua_Integer is long in the native LP64 profile; its existing specialization handles both.
edits.reason: The native Lua integer type is long, making the two otherwise identical specializations a redefinition. The build asserts this type identity.

edits.name: disable-unused-x86-tick-assembly
edits.reason: The x86 naked-function helpers are unused by CP; the native build uses the host FTimer/performance-counter methods.

edits.name: native-swap-exception-specification
edits.reason: Match the libc++ primary swap template exception specification; the swap body is unchanged.

edits.name: empty-variadic-log-arguments
edits.reason: Clang requires the comma-swallowing extension when these log macros are called without additional arguments.

edits.name: omit-unused-flua-private-error-handler-api
edits.reason: CP does not use these local SDK callback classes and Aspyr does not export their methods. Forward declarations exclude their Windows-only function/member-pointer cast; any future use must gain a real native implementation.

edits.name: pointer-width-batch-allocation-alignment
edits.reason: Preserve the full native pointer value before computing allocation alignment.

edits.name: empty-variadic-precondition-arguments
edits.reason: Preserve upstream assertion behavior when Clang expands a call with no optional format arguments.

edits.name: empty-variadic-assertion-arguments
edits.reason: Preserve upstream assertion behavior when Clang expands a call with no optional format arguments.

edits.name: lp64-spy-count-vector-size
edits.reason: The vector size is native size_t rather than Win32 uint; compare both counts in size_t without changing the minimum or loop behavior.

edits.name: exclude-windows-modpack-creation-tool
edits.pattern: (?s)(// Modpack making functions by Gedemon/cicero225\b.*?CvString CvGame::GetModFromIdAndVersion\b.*?\breturn CvString\(\);\s*\})
edits.reason: The optional in-game DLC authoring tool uses Windows registry discovery and hard-coded Windows paths. Its Lua calls explicitly report unavailability on Mac; loading and playing packaged mod content is independent.

edits.name: report-native-modpack-authoring-unavailable
edits.replacement: int CvLuaGame::l\1(lua_State* L) { return luaL_error(L, "In-game modpack creation is unavailable on macOS; use a prepared modpack."); }
edits.reason: Keep the five optional authoring APIs discoverable but raise an explicit Lua error before doing any filesystem work, rather than claiming success or emulating Windows registry and path behavior.

edits.name: guard-windows-process-memory-header
edits.reason: This header is needed only by Windows diagnostic code; the native process-memory log uses Mach task_info.

edits.name: replace-windows-process-memory-log
edits.reason: The Mac implementation in platform_support.cpp logs actual task resident memory and physical footprint without introducing fake Windows process handles.

edits.name: copy-builder-directive-pair-with-lvalue-arguments
edits.reason: Use the same explicit pair type and copy its lvalue directive; modern make_pair uses forwarding references that cannot bind these explicitly supplied types.

edits.name: input-map-allocator-const-key
edits.reason: The allocator value_type must match the standard map value_type, which has a const key. CP uses only keyboard constants from this input header and does not construct native input devices.

edits.name: lp64-tactical-choice-count
edits.reason: Compare candidate counts in native size_t, preserving the existing maximum and branch calculation.

edits.name: native-sdk-dword-width
edits.reason: Aspyr FCRC::Calc takes a 32-bit unsigned int and its CRC table has 32-bit entries. Keep the SDK dword width fixed on LP64.

edits.name: native-fstring-initializer-c-linkage
edits.reason: Aspyr exports the two empty-string initializer accessors with C linkage even when the game core is compiled as a DLL.

edits.name: native-fatal-precondition-log
edits.pattern: void CvPreconditionDlg\(const char\* expr, const char\* szFile, unsigned int uiLine, const char\* msg\)\s*\{
edits.reason: Keep upstream's fatal trap while recording its actual formatted failure on macOS, where the Windows dialog and crash logger do not run.

edits.name: native-game-database-cache-result
edits.reason: Record completion of the real upstream gameplay cache separately from the private database ABI smoke test.

edits.name: native-game-database-log-header
edits.reason: Declare the native cache-result diagnostic at the existing translation-unit include boundary.

edits.name: native-lua-bridge-startup-check
edits.reason: Exercise native Lua table access, metamethods, stack replacement and protected compilation/calls once on private stack objects before registering CP bindings. Restore the stack and log the result.

edits.name: native-core-save-guid
edits.reason: Give Mac-format experimental saves a stable identity distinct from stock and Windows CP, without changing upstream constants or interface slots.

edits.name: native-game-save-header-read
edits.reason: Reject a missing/foreign Mac format tag before the upstream game reset and field parser; do not fork gameplay serialization.

edits.name: native-game-save-header-write
edits.reason: Prefix the upstream game payload with the fixed Mac magic, format number and GUID. Upstream keeps ownership of all following fields.
